objectives.statement: State a clear view using common opinion openings such as Jeg synes and etter min mening.
Give reasons with fordi and siden in short, correct sentences.
Link two points with for det første and for det andre so the text has sammenheng.
Build a short coherent opinion text with an opening, reasons, and a closing sentence.

notes: Must teach how to write a short, coherent explanation or opinion text in Norwegian: stating a view, giving reasons (fordi, siden), linking points (for det første/for det andre), and closing briefly. Defer advanced cohesive devices to discourse_cohesion and register nuance to formal_vs_informal_register.
